summary: easyway2 preinstall scans filesystem for JWT tokens and beacons to ngrok tunnel
details: The package's package.json preinstall lifecycle script spawns a shell that recursively searches the entire filesystem (from / on Unix, C:\ on Windows) for strings matching a JWT regex (ey[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.[...]\.[...]). In parallel it issues an HTTP GET to http://crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev/scan_started carrying the installer's OS username (process.env.USERNAME or process.env.USER). Execution is automatic on `npm install` with no user opt-in. The destination is an anonymous ngrok tunnel bearing no relation to any publisher, and traffic is unauthenticated plain HTTP. The package presents no legitimate purpose that would justify a whole-disk JWT search or an install-time callback to an anonymous tunnel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
